concept: independent Korean summer harem-trouser topology test
negative_en: cartoon style, fake-looking background, 3D render look, broken facial features, body distortion, over-processed retouching, distorted fingers, unrealistic hands, plastic-looking skin
prompt_en: Create a full-body 40 mm editorial at a dawn vinyl market beneath a concrete rail viaduct after summer rain. Show a clearly adult woman with long dark center-parted softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, natural makeup, and a calm expression, guided only by the visible adult appearance in the attached portrait. She lifts one record from a crate while stepping across a shallow puddle. A fitted graphite top contrasts with lightweight olive harem trousers: one gathered waistband releases substantial fabric into both trouser legs; the seat and crotch remain visibly roomy beneath the waistband during her forward step; loose folds preserve pronounced volume through both hips and thighs; multiple folds converge separately into two narrow gathered ankle cuffs; the gathered cuffs distinguish the silhouette from straight wide legs and smooth balloon hems at both ankles. A full-length, low eye-level frame leaves clear breathing room beneath both translucent jelly sandals. Keep the waist, seat, two outer-leg contours, both cuffs, and footwear visible together in a diagonal stance. Cool diffused dawn ambient light separates the olive folds from wet concrete, while amber stall bulbs edge her silhouette.
